platformData.note: same record as levels; progress.init reads cleared stages, best stars and best score per stage from it

functions.trigger: After sdk:core:ready and on every return to S03 Stage Map / S02 Lobby: progress.init reads the campaign state (cleared stages, stars, Siege unlock after stage 5). gamestate.get on boot, gamestate.set after every levelEnd ACK (campaign.gun_level carry, campaign.last_stage, campaign.selected_chapter, siege.best_local mirror).
functions.player: Stage Map shows unlocked nodes with 0-3 stars; Siege button unlocks after stage 5; after reload the same nodes and stars are shown and the gun level carries to the next stage.

platformData.rewards: first clear: 1 booster by rotation (N-1) mod 4 of [bst_bubble, bst_shockwave, bst_fortify, bst_hull]; first 3 stars: +1 bst_bubble; finals 10/20/30: +1 of each booster

functions.trigger: S04 Pre-stage Start: levels.open(set) + handle.get(n), then progress.beginAttempt (server seed, start needs network). S07 Stage Clear / S08 Defeat / S09 Siege Result: progress.levelEnd({set, n, seed, score, won, durationMs, ...}, {eventId}) with retries 2/4/8/16/32 s on the same eventId.
functions.player: Stage layout comes from the Levels section; after a win S07 shows server-verified stars, score and the large booster reward picture; offline Start shows 'Connection needed'.

functions.trigger: S09 Siege Result and Siege button in S02: leaderboards.rank(siege_best board) gives the player's best score of the week; 'NEW BEST!' when the run score is greater. Per-stage best score/stars come from progress.init (function progress).
functions.player: Siege Result shows 'Best' and 'NEW BEST!'; after reload Best equals the server value, not a local number.

functions.excluded: No currency in the first version. Game design chose soft currency Scrap with permanent sinks (Garage upgrades, hull skin collection, bonus chapters), but the platform cannot yet publish exchange rules and a starting balance, so Scrap is a next-stage item (GDD 15 meta.next). Hard currency is not used at all. Consumable boosters live in the inventory function.

functions.trigger: Boot and after every grant (purchase, daily, level reward, start grant, inventory:state:changed): inventory.get / refresh, counters via inventory.quantity. Booster tap in S05: effect applied in the same tick, inventory.consume(item, 1, {reason, idempotencyKey}) in parallel (3 retries 1/2/4 s). Spare Hull in S04 and continue in S08: only after consume confirmation.
functions.player: Booster buttons in HUD and Pre-stage show server counts; a used booster decreases the count; after reload the counts equal the server balance.

functions.excluded: Internal shop for currency (inventory.exchange) and the starting set are not used yet: the platform function is not finished. Garage upgrades for Scrap are described in GDD 15 meta.next as the next stage; no own currency shop is built.

functions.trigger: Boot: iap.load. S10 Shop open: iap.products for localized prices. Buy tap in S10 / S08 / S04 / auto Starter Crate window: iap.purchase(offer) then iap.waitOrder until granted; grant goes to inventory on the server.
functions.player: Shop shows 5 packs with prices; after a test purchase S11 shows the large booster pictures with amounts and the counters grow; after reload the boosters are still there.

platformData.note: one-time free claim per player = GDD 15 meta.grant, claimed with iap.purchase; separate from daily and level rewards

functions.trigger: S10 Shop: iap.offers({placement:'shop'}) in iap.shop_order. S08 Defeat when continue is available and Spare Hull = 0: iap.offers({placement:'defeat'}). S04 Pre-stage when Spare Hull = 0: iap.offer hull_pack. Auto window Starter Crate (first defeat / first clear of stage 3, cooldown 24 h, at most 3 shows). First entry to S02: iap.offer start_grant -> Collect -> iap.purchase (free).
functions.player: Offers appear in Shop, Defeat and Pre-stage; Starter Crate disappears after it is bought; the first-visit window shows 2x each booster and Collect grants them once.

platformData.source: progress levelEnd score of level-set siege

platformData.aggregate: sum of best score per campaign stage
platformData.source: progress levelEnd score of level-set campaign

functions.trigger: S13 Leaderboards open (HUD icon): leaderboards.get(board) + leaderboards.around(board). Scores are written by the server from the progress source (clientAuthoritative false); leaderboards.submitScore is called only when leaderboards.canSubmit is true (S09 run end, campaign sum grew after levelEnd, D-31-06).
functions.player: S13 shows both boards with the player's own row; after a Siege run the player's row and place update; after reload the row is the same.

functions.trigger: Boot: progress.init('daily') state -> daily-rewards.setNextRewardAt(endsAt) (badge on HUD icon, autoOpen when claimable). HUD icon / auto window: daily-rewards.open -> S12 calendar from daily-rewards.plan + server claimed count. Claim button: progress.send({eventId, type: claim action of the track, data: {operationId}}) (action type from mod-progress contracts, clarified by integration).
functions.player: Calendar of 7 days with large booster pictures; Claim grants today's boosters (counters grow), the badge disappears, the timer to the next reward shows; after reload today is claimed.

functions.trigger: S02 Lobby and S13 own row: profile.get (nickname, avatar). S14 Settings 'ManyPlay ID' button: portal.openId.
functions.player: Player name/avatar in Lobby and in leaderboards; ManyPlay ID opens from Settings; after reload the same name.

functions.trigger: Boot: kv.get('settings') and onboarding/offer flags (onb.*, tut.*, offer.starter.last_auto_at, offer.starter.auto_shows, flag.first_defeat_seen, booster_info.seen). Toggle in S14 (Music, Sound, Reduce Motion, Vibration) and every flag event: kv.set right away.
functions.player: Settings toggles keep their state; tutorial and Starter Crate auto window are not shown twice; after reload the toggles and flags are the same.

platformData.note: field, player, bullets, stage size, curve by chapter, score bonuses (GDD 31 plat.configs)
item ids, effects, per-stage limits, siege multiplier
unlock stage, level-set id, waves, lives, scoring
display only: rotation, 3-star, finals, start grant, daily preview, level-set id, board keys
HUD icon layout (daily, shop, leaderboards, settings)

functions.trigger: After boot: configs.getScope('game') / configs.get(key) validated against configs/schemas, built-in default on a broken key. configs:snapshot:updated and return to Lobby: configs.refresh. Configs is core (sdk.configs); field module = progress because platform.json sdk.modules does not declare core and mod-progress (levels.open) is the declared module that reads configs records.
functions.player: Balance, boosters, Siege waves and offers follow the published values; a changed value applies without a new build.

functions.trigger: No events or seasons in MVP (liveops false). realtime delivers pushes the game reacts to: inventory balance changes and iap.order.granted (counters update without polling), configs reload, broadcast notice. realtime.notice on S02 open -> announcement/maintenance banner; realtime.status -> offline indicator.
functions.player: Counters update right after a purchase or reward; an announcement or maintenance banner appears in Lobby when the platform sends one.

functions.trigger: Events of GDD 32 (an.app_ready, an.stage_start, an.stage_end, an.booster_use, an.reward_granted, an.daily_claim, an.offer_shown, an.purchase_result, ...) are sent with sdk.analytics.sendEvent. Core analytics; without a registered provider the call is a no-op (no own transport, no third-party SDK). Field module = ui-kit because core is not declared in platform.json sdk.modules.
functions.player: Nothing visible; the funnel is available as soon as the platform registers an analytics provider.

functions.trigger: After boot: hud.register for daily, shop, leaderboards, settings icons with badge handles (daily ready, Starter Crate available). Lobby buttons duplicate entries through hud.open.
functions.player: Lobby top bar icons with badges open Daily, Shop, Leaderboards and Settings.
